parsed.explanation: No trans-presentation offence, facility ban or border rule is documented, so severity is not state-imposed universal exposure. However, an active buggery law criminalising consensual same-sex conduct, documented police harassment including of trans women, police leaking details and failing to investigate LGBT violence including murder, and a 2023 report of common severe prisoner-on-prisoner violence targeted at LGBTQI+ prisoners in harsh, overcrowded custody with no gender-recognition framework for accommodation, show a hostile, impunity-prone environment if outed. Public opinion is consistently hostile, a 2013 mob killing of a gender-nonconforming teenager remained unsolved, and police in 2019 said they could not protect LGBT residents. Thin formal recourse plus documented targeted custody and police failure place this below the 0.35 unremedied-exposure tier, but without documented organised trans sweeps or imprisonment for presentation itself.
